items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: they had Rene and myself, Edna Mitchell, Joe Rene, Chester Lazard, and Henry Harden, Thomas on guitar, and they had Manny Gabriel, Handy, and this boy over the river, from over the lake, ten pieces.

ctx.x: Andy. Andy. Henry Harden. Where did Henry Harden play? Henry Harden. Henry Harden played the saxophone. But he wouldn't play alto. No, he played the baritone.

items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: Who else was in the Eureka then when you joined? ... Well, at that time there was Willie Wilson, Johnny Wilson, myself, Connish, Flowers, Flowers. ... Groundhog? Yeah, Groundhog.

ctx.x: Who else was in the Eureka then when you joined?

Well, at that time there was Willie Wilson, Johnny Wilson, myself, Connish, Flowers, Flowers. Let's see who they had on the bass drum. I think Lil' Jimmy was playing. What the other? Groundhog? Yeah, Groundhog. Groundhog? Yeah.
